title: Batch of RDP changes
description:
This PR contains a serie of changes in the RDP dissectors:
* added dissecting of printer and smartcard commands in the rdpdr channel
* added rdpecam channel dissecting
* added initial dissecting of undocumented conctrl channel
* reassemble static channel packets before sending them to channel dissecting
* improve and interpret more fields in cliprdr, egfx, rail and rdpudp dissectors
* make rdpudp work without specific configuration (not having tpkt taking priority on top of tls embedded in rdpudp)

commits_data.title: rdpudp: various fixes
commits_data.message:
rdpudp: various fixes

This patch addresses various bugs with the rdpudp dissector:

* fix connection matches between the TCP and UDP parts (it's not necessary
  to match addresses and ports)
* let the heuristics do their job instead of forcing TKPT on top of tls.port==3389
* add some useful info on acked packet range

commits_data.message:
rdp_dr: add parsing for smartcard and printers commands

This patch adds support for most of smartcard commands on the RDPDR channel.
It also adds parsing of printer commands.

commits_data.message: rdp: add parsing of AAD flag

commits_data.title: rdp: add initial dissecting for the conctrl channel
commits_data.message:
rdp: add initial dissecting for the conctrl channel

This patch adds the dissecting for the undocumented conctrl channel. It's not
documented, but some fields can be easily guessed.
The patch also changes a bit the dissecting as this channel exchange packets
before the licence exchange.

commits_data.title: rdp: implement reassembly of channel messages
commits_data.message:
rdp: implement reassembly of channel messages

Before this patch the traffic on RDP channels was given to upper layers as
is. Even if most, if not all, of the protocols expect to treat a full packet of
reassembled fragments. This patch implements channels chunks reassembly so that for
instance big RDPDR packets splitted over many PDUs get dissected correctly.

commits_data.title: rdp_dr: parse capability packets
commits_data.message:
rdp_dr: parse capability packets

This patch adds the parsing of capabilities packets in RDPDR, only the general
capability has some meaningfull content.

commits_data.title: rdp_egfx: parse more fields and treat some "modified but unused" warnings
commits_data.message:
rdp_egfx: parse more fields and treat some "modified but unused" warnings

This patch adds the parsing of more fields: codecId, codecContextId, cache slot and
cache key. It also improve pixelFormat. And finally it removes statement where offset
is modified but never read after that.
